script.cite: BK2 printed p.10 = book2-3-4.pdf PDF p.16
script.quote: This simple circuit may be thought of as a manual memory: as long as the pushbutton is being held DOWN, the relay remembers a one.

script.cite: BK2 printed p.10 = book2-3-4.pdf PDF p.16
script.quote: When the pushbutton is released, the relay forgets the one and starts remembering a zero.
